ἠΰτε , Ep. Particle,
A.as, like as, “ἠ. κούρη”
Il. 2.872
, etc.; “ἠ. νεβρός”
B. 12.87
; freq. in similes, Il. 1.359 , 2.87 , etc.: after a Comp. , τῷ δέ τ᾽ ἄνευθεν ἐόντι μελάντερον ἠ. πίσσα φαίνεται [the cloud] appears to him while afar off very black, even as pitch, 4.277 , v. Sch.; ἔχετο κλαίουσ᾽ ἀδινώτερον, ἠΰτε κούρη with sobs coming quicker and quicker, like a girl, A.R. 1.269 ; but it may = than in these passages; cf. εὖτε. (ἤ + I.- E.
ute (cf. Skt. uta) 'also', 'even'.)
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
